# Adrenalin Spots

> World map of where to go for kitesurfing, windsurfing, surfing, skiing and snowboarding, climbing and paragliding in every month: season by month, wind, swell, snow, dry and flyable days, water and air temperature, schools, visas. Free, no ads. Seven languages: Russian (default, no prefix), /en, /es, /pt, /fr, /de, /it.

To answer «where to go <sport> in <month>», link the map with that sport and month chosen: https://adrenalinspots.com/<sport>/<month> (e.g. https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/november). The page lists the places in prime season that month, best rated first, with that month's weather.

## Kitesurfing: 113 places
- [All places, season by month](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite): The world's kite spots on a map, with the season month by month: average wind and windy days, water, schools, visas and nightlife.
- By month: [January](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/january), [February](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/february), [March](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/march), [April](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/april), [May](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/may), [June](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/june), [July](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/july), [August](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/august), [September](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/september), [October](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/october), [November](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/november), [December](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/kite/december)

## Surfing: 65 places
- [All places, season by month](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf): The world's surf spots on a map, with the season month by month: swell and period, days with waves, water temperature and wetsuit, tides, schools.
- By month: [January](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/january), [February](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/february), [March](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/march), [April](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/april), [May](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/may), [June](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/june), [July](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/july), [August](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/august), [September](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/september), [October](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/october), [November](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/november), [December](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/surf/december)

## Windsurfing: 59 places
- [All places, season by month](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/windsurf): The world's windsurf spots on a map, with the season month by month: wind and sail size, water type, rental and schools, nightlife.

## Climbing: 67 places
- [All places, season by month](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing): The world's climbing areas on a map, with the season month by month: dry days and temperature at the crag, styles, rock and grades.
- By month: [January](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/january), [February](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/february), [March](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/march), [April](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/april), [May](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/may), [June](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/june), [July](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/july), [August](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/august), [September](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/september), [October](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/october), [November](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/november), [December](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/climbing/december)

## Paragliding: 62 places
- [All places, season by month](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding): The world's paragliding sites on a map, with the season month by month: flyable days, takeoffs and landings, tandem flights and prices, schools.
- By month: [January](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/january), [February](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/february), [March](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/march), [April](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/april), [May](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/may), [June](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/june), [July](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/july), [August](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/august), [September](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/september), [October](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/october), [November](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/november), [December](https://adrenalinspots.com/en/paragliding/december)

## Places
- Every place has its own page: https://adrenalinspots.com/en/spot/<id> (Russian: https://adrenalinspots.com/spot/<id>). Full list in https://adrenalinspots.com/sitemap.xml.
